user.title: Samsung Frame TV
user.description: Turn the TV on, then enter its IP address. Tip: give it a DHCP reservation in your router so the IP never changes.

pair.title: Pair with your {model}
pair.description: Click **Submit**, then pick up the TV remote. Within 30 seconds the TV will ask to allow **Home Assistant** to connect. Choose **Allow**.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the TV. Make sure it's on and the IP is correct.
error.denied: The TV denied the connection (or the prompt timed out). Try again and choose Allow.
error.pair_failed: Pairing failed. Make sure the TV is on and try again.

abort.already_configured: This TV is already set up.

init.title: Apps and inputs
init.description:
One per line as `Name: value`. Apps use the Tizen app ID (add `, native` if an app won't open). Inputs use a remote key such as KEY_HDMI1.

Optional: pick this TV's **SmartThings** media player so the card can show which input is active.
